content: All 32 cards have a 1:1 Spanish twin (marketing/script-cards/mccray/output/mccray-es-NN.png) — independently drafted + verified translations, since McCray has no bilingual source text for these lines. Example, Card 1: hook "Cuando digan 'no puedo'", say "Agrega una palabra chiquita. No puedo ganar… ¡TODAVÍA!"
